records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、キャンプってやったことある？
records.en_original: Have you ever been camping, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you ever been camping, Ao?
records.en: Have you ever been camping, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 本格的なのはないかなぁ……<CR>小学校の林間学校ぐらい？
records.en_original: Not really... Going to summer camp is as close as I've gotten.
records.en_auxiliary: Not really... Going to summer camp is as close as I've gotten.
records.en: Not really... Going to summer camp<CR>is as close as I've gotten.

records.jp: 私、キャンプとかサバイバルとか<CR>ちょっと憧れてるんだよねー
records.en_original: I've always been kinda fascinated with camping and wilderness survival.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always been kinda fascinated with camping and wilderness survival.
records.en: I've always been kinda fascinated with<CR>camping and wilderness survival.

records.jp: 何から何まで、自分の力でやるって<CR>楽しそうだなと思って
records.en_original: Like, how far would you be able to make it on your own? It seems fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Like, how far would you be able to make it on your own? It seems fun.
records.en: I thought it sounded fun<CR>to do absolutely everything by your own strength.

records.jp: （陽桜莉さん、意外とパワフルだからな。<CR>たしかに、向いてるかも……）
records.en_original: (Hiori is stronger than she looks. That kind of thing sounds right up her alley...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hiori is stronger than she looks. That kind of thing sounds right up her alley...)
records.en: (Hiori-san is stronger than she looks. That kind of<CR>thing sounds right up her alley...)

records.jp: 私、無人島とか行ってみたいな
records.en_original: I've always wanted to go to a desert island.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always wanted to go to a desert island.
records.en: I've always wanted to go to a desert island.

records.jp: あ、いいねー！<CR>海に潜って、お魚たくさん獲ったり！
records.en_original: Oh, that sounds nice! We could dive in the ocean and catch lots of fish!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, that sounds nice! We could dive in the ocean and catch lots of fish!
records.en: Oh, that sounds nice!<CR>We could dive in the ocean and catch lots of fish!

records.jp: そうそう！<CR>絶対美味しいよね！
records.en_original: Exactly! The fish would be so good too!
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly! The fish would be so good too!
records.en: Exactly! The<CR>fish would be so good too!

records.jp: 塩を軽く振って焼くだけで<CR>最高に美味しいんだろうねぇ～……
records.en_original: Throw a pinch of salt on it and grill it over an open flame... That sounds amazing.
records.en_auxiliary: Throw a pinch of salt on it and grill it over an open flame... That sounds amazing.
records.en: Throw a pinch of salt on it and grill<CR>it over an open flame... That sounds amazing.

records.jp: うん、一度でいいから食べてみたいねえ……
records.en_original: Yeah. I'd like to try that at least once.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I'd like to try that at least once.
records.en: Yeah. I'd like to try that at least once.

records.jp: 静かな山の奥とかいいよね
records.en_original: There's nothing better than being out in the mountains.
records.en_auxiliary: There's nothing better than being out in the mountains.
records.en: There's nothing better than being out in the mountains.

records.jp: あー、いいねえ！　山菜とか、木の実とか<CR>美味しいものもたくさんあるだろうし
records.en_original: Yeah! I bet you could find all kinds of tasty wild plants or fruits and nuts.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! I bet you could find all kinds of tasty wild plants or fruits and nuts.
records.en: Yeah! I bet you could find all kinds of<CR>tasty wild plants or fruits and nuts.

records.jp: こころちゃんに頼んだら<CR>動物を狩ってくれるかもしれないよね
records.en_original: If we ask nicely, Kokoro might hunt some kind of animal for us.
records.en_auxiliary: If we ask nicely, Kokoro might hunt some kind of animal for us.
records.en: If we ask nicely, Kokoro-chan<CR>might hunt some kind of animal for us.

records.jp: うん、一度でいいから食べてみたいねえ……
records.en_original: Yeah. I'd like to try that at least once.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I'd like to try that at least once.
records.en: Yeah. I'd like to try that at least once.

records.jp: ……あれ？<CR>結局、食べることしか考えてなくない？
records.en_original: Wait... All we're talking about is just food!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait... All we're talking about is just food!
records.en: Wait... All<CR>we're talking about is just food!

records.jp: あ、ほんとだ！<CR>大事なこと、他にもあるのにね
records.en_original: You're right! There are other important things too!
records.en_auxiliary: You're right! There are other important things too!
records.en: You're right! There<CR>are other important things too!

records.jp: だよね。例えば……
records.en_original: Yeah. For example...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. For example...
records.en: Yeah. For example...

records.jp: 寝る場所とか？
records.en_original: Where would we sleep?
records.en_auxiliary: Where would we sleep?
records.en: Where would we sleep?

records.jp: そうだね、テントがあればいいけど<CR>もし何もなければ、自分でつくらないといけないし
records.en_original: Hmm, yeah. You'd be fine if you had a tent, but otherwise you'd have to fashion something yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, yeah. You'd be fine if you had a tent, but otherwise you'd have to fashion something yourself.
records.en: Hmm, yeah. You'd be fine if you had a tent,<CR>but otherwise you'd have to fashion something yourself.

records.jp: 大きな葉っぱとか、木の枝とか集めれば<CR>ベッドぐらいできるかな？
records.en_original: If you gathered up some big leaves and tree branches, you could probably make some kind of bed.
records.en_auxiliary: If you gathered up some big leaves and tree branches, you could probably make some kind of bed.
records.en: If you gathered up some big leaves and tree branches, you<CR>could probably make some kind of bed.

records.jp: 毛布とかないから、夜は寒いかもね
records.en_original: It'd be cold at night without a blanket, though.
records.en_auxiliary: It'd be cold at night without a blanket, though.
records.en: It'd be cold at night without a blanket, though.

records.jp: そしたら、ふたりでくっついて寝ようよ。<CR>ぎゅーってすれば、きっと暖かいよ
records.en_original: In that case, we'd just have to sleep together. If we snuggle up I'm sure we'd be warm.
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, we'd just have to sleep together. If we snuggle up I'm sure we'd be warm.
records.en: In that case, we'd just have to sleep together.<CR>If we snuggle up I'm sure we'd be warm.

records.jp: あはは、たしかに。<CR>じゃあ、それで決まり！
records.en_original: Haha, that's true. Let's do it then!
records.en_auxiliary: Haha, that's true. Let's do it then!
records.en: Haha, that's true.<CR>Let's do it then!

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: 火おこしとか？
records.en_original: Can you start a fire?
records.en_auxiliary: Can you start a fire?
records.en: Can you start a fire?

records.jp: まず最初は、火をおこすべし……って言うもんね
records.en_original: Ah, they say that the first thing you should do is get a fire going.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, they say that the first thing you should do is get a fire going.
records.en: Ah, they say that the first thing you should do is get a fire going.

records.jp: マッチとかライターとかあればいいけど、<CR>マジで何もなかったら、どうしようか？
records.en_original: As long as we had matches or a lighter we'd be fine, but could we really start a fire from scratch?
records.en_auxiliary: As long as we had matches or a lighter we'd be fine, but could we really start a fire from scratch?
records.en: As long as we had matches or a lighter we'd be fine,<CR>but could we really start a fire from scratch?

records.jp: やっぱり、木をこすって火をつけるしかないよね
records.en_original: I guess we'd just have to rub sticks together.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess we'd just have to rub sticks together.
records.en: I guess we'd just have to rub sticks together.

records.jp: うわー……私、絶対無理！<CR>火がつく前に、ダウンすると思う
records.en_original: Yikes, I don't think I could do that! I'd wear myself out before I ever made a fire.
records.en_auxiliary: Yikes, I don't think I could do that! I'd wear myself out before I ever made a fire.
records.en: Yikes, I don't think I could do that!<CR>I'd wear myself out before I ever made a fire.

records.jp: じゃあ、火おこしは私に任せて！<CR>体力には自信があるし！
records.en_original: Leave it to me, then! I'm sure I could do it!
records.en_auxiliary: Leave it to me, then! I'm sure I could do it!
records.en: Leave it to me, then! I'm<CR>sure I could do it!

records.jp: おお、頼もしい！
records.en_original: Ooh, my hero!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, my hero!
records.en: Ooh, my hero!

records.jp: でも、美弦さんとかきららがいたら、<CR>簡単に火をおこす方法知ってそうだよね
records.en_original: But if Mio or Kirara were there, I'm sure they'd know how to start a fire easily.
records.en_auxiliary: But if Mio or Kirara were there, I'm sure they'd know how to start a fire easily.
records.en: But if Mio-san or Kirara were there, I'm<CR>sure they'd know how to start a fire easily.

records.jp: あはは、言えてる！
records.en_original: Ahaha, that's for sure!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, that's for sure!
records.en: Ahaha, that's for sure!

records.jp: うーん、いろいろ話してたら<CR>本当にやりたくなってきたー
records.en_original: Ah, the more we talk about it, the more it makes me wanna do it!
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, the more we talk about it, the more it makes me wanna do it!
records.en: Ah, the more we talk about it,<CR>the more it makes me wanna do it!

records.jp: あちこち探索して、食材とか素材とか見つけて<CR>テントに戻って、料理したりクラフトしたり……
records.en_original: We could explore, find ingredients and materials, then go back to the tent to cook and craft things...
records.en_auxiliary: We could explore, find ingredients and materials, then go back to the tent to cook and craft things...
records.en: We could explore, find ingredients and materials,<CR>then go back to the tent to cook and craft things...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、どうしたの？
records.en_original: What is it, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it, Ao?
records.en: What is it, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 私達の今の状況って……サバイバルじゃない？
records.en_original: Aren't we all in a survival situation already?
records.en_auxiliary: Aren't we all in a survival situation already?
records.en: Aren't we all in a survival situation already?

records.jp: ……はっ！？<CR>言われてみれば！？
records.en_original: What?! Now that you mention it...we totally are!
records.en_auxiliary: What?! Now that you mention it...we totally are!
records.en: What?! Now that you<CR>mention it...we totally are!

records.jp: っていうか、ガチサバイバルっしょ！<CR>この世界、私達しかいないわけだし！
records.en_original: And this is the ultimate wilderness survival too! We're the only ones in this entire world!
records.en_auxiliary: And this is the ultimate wilderness survival too! We're the only ones in this entire world!
records.en: And this is the ultimate wilderness survival too!<CR>We're the only ones in this entire world!

records.jp: ほわ～……ほんとだあ！<CR>もう、サバイバルしてたー
records.en_original: Jeez...you're right. We've been surviving this whole time!
records.en_auxiliary: Jeez...you're right. We've been surviving this whole time!
records.en: Jeez...you're right. We've<CR>been surviving this whole time!

records.jp: なんで、気づかなかったんだろう？
records.en_original: How did that thought never occur to me?
records.en_auxiliary: How did that thought never occur to me?
records.en: How did that thought never occur to me?

records.jp: この生活に慣れすぎたのかな？
records.en_original: Maybe we've gotten too used to life here?
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe we've gotten too used to life here?
records.en: Maybe we've gotten too used to life here?

records.jp: ここで過ごすことが<CR>当たり前になってきちゃったしね
records.en_original: Living here has started to feel pretty normal.
records.en_auxiliary: Living here has started to feel pretty normal.
records.en: Living here has<CR>started to feel pretty normal.

records.jp: うーん、それはあるかも。初めてこの世界に<CR>来たときは、あんなに驚いたのになあ
records.en_original: Hmm, you might be onto something. It was such a shock when I first came here, but now...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, you might be onto something. It was such a shock when I first came here, but now...
records.en: Hmm, you might be onto something. It was such a<CR>shock when I first came here, but now...

records.jp: でも、みんながいなかったら、<CR>きっと今も、やっていけなかったと思う
records.en_original: I don't think we would have made it this far without everyone here, though.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think we would have made it this far without everyone here, though.
records.en: I don't think we would have made<CR>it this far without everyone here, though.

records.jp: ひとりじゃないって、幸せなことなんだろうね
records.en_original: There's happiness to be found in not being alone.
records.en_auxiliary: There's happiness to be found in not being alone.
records.en: There's happiness to be found in not being alone.

records.jp: うん……そうだね。<CR>愛央ちゃん。私も、そう思うよ
records.en_original: Yeah... That's so true. I think so too, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... That's so true. I think so too, Ao!
records.en: Yeah... That's so<CR>true. I think so too, Ao-chan!

records.jp: 非現実的すぎるからかな？
records.en_original: Maybe it's just too surreal?
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe it's just too surreal?
records.en: Maybe because it is too unreal?

records.jp: 無人島みたいに何もないってわけじゃないし<CR>学校とか、施設とか、いろいろあるしね
records.en_original: It's not like we're on a desert island where there's nothing at all. We have a school and all these other facilities...
records.en_auxiliary: It's not like we're on a desert island where there's nothing at all. We have a school and all these other facilities...
records.en: It's not like we're on a desert island where there's nothing at<CR>all. We have a school and all these other facilities...

records.jp: かといって、現実の世界とも違うし……<CR>本当の意味で雫世界を受け入れきれてないのかも
records.en_original: But on the other hand, it's nothing like the real world... Maybe I haven't truly accepted Oasis yet.
records.en_auxiliary: But on the other hand, it's nothing like the real world... Maybe I haven't truly accepted Oasis yet.
records.en: But on the other hand, it's nothing like the<CR>real world... Maybe I haven't truly accepted Oasis yet.

records.jp: 夢なのか現実なのか……その間なのか。<CR>まだ分からないことも、いっぱいあるもんね
records.en_original: There's so much we still don't know. Like if this is a dream or real life or something in between...
records.en_auxiliary: There's so much we still don't know. Like if this is a dream or real life or something in between...
records.en: There's so much we still don't know. Like if this<CR>is a dream or real life or something in between...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: でも、今の私たちが<CR>ここにいることだけは、確かだよ
records.en_original: But what we do know for sure is that we are here now.
records.en_auxiliary: But what we do know for sure is that we are here now.
records.en: But what we do know<CR>for sure is that we are here now.

records.jp: 元の世界に戻れる日まで……<CR>みんなで、頑張らないとね！
records.en_original: So we have to keep working together until we make it back to our world!
records.en_auxiliary: So we have to keep working together until we make it back to our world!
records.en: So we have to keep working together<CR>until we make it back to our world!

records.jp: うん！　そうだね！
records.en_original: Yeah! You're right!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! You're right!
records.en: Yeah! You're right!

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
